item.subject: maths
item.stem: The graph shows Class A and Class B student counts for Monday and Tuesday as adjacent bars on a common scale.

parts.text: Which claim correctly reads the graph?

options.text: Call the display a double column graph only, with no comparison of bar heights.
On Monday, Class A has $18$ students and Class B has $12$; on Tuesday, Class A has $22$ and Class B has $16$, read from adjacent bars on one scale.
Drawing adjacent bars is what creates the Monday and Tuesday categories.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
